title: ingestion_queue bytes limit TOCTOU allows exceeding max_pending_bytes
description: In crates/transit/src/peering/ingestion_queue.rs, try_enqueue reads bytes_current as a separate atomic before calling try_send on the channel. Two concurrent callers can both read below the threshold and both push, collectively exceeding max_pending_bytes. The depth limit is protected by the channel's bounded capacity, but the bytes limit is not. Use a dedicated Semaphore or combine the check with the channel push under a lock.
